I found the staff very pleasant always a smile on their face. I was very happy with them. I always thought it was a cheap holiday in Bali but the cost of the beverages was just as expensive as it is in Australia.   When I asked for a room change with a balcony so I could have a cigarette. I had to pay extra money. I phoned the resort a month prior to me arriving to clarify that they had changed our room to sleep three people. They told me to email reservations which I did and I never got a reply back. When we arrived, they did not have a room that I asked for and I had to pay for three nights extra for my granddaughter and when I asked for a room change I had to pay another 300,000.  all in all, I loved Bali but I will never stay at your resort again or recommended to anybody.
